trap.label: rise ≠ raise
trap.why: Raise é transitivo (aumentar algo). Rise é intransitivo: o preço subiu sozinho.

fix.wrong: In my point of view, it is fair.
fix.right: In my view, it is fair.

fix.wrong: There is an increase of cars.
fix.right: There is an increase in cars.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com the author argues that: “It's unfair.” (author)
rewrite.answer: The author argues that it is unfair.

rewrite.prompt: Passe ao plural: “The graph shows a rise.”

rewrite.answer: There was an increase in sales.
